GMB.note: The document covers the data protection act only; nothing on an access to information law.
Only the act's protection from automated decision-making is named, as a data subject right under the data protection act; no AI rule or authority is stated.

facts.fact: OneTrust DataGuidance reports on 8 December 2025 that the Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act (Act No. 11 of 2025), passed by the National Assembly on 29 September 2025, received presidential assent on 7 November 2025 and was gazetted on 13 November 2025, and its headline says the Act goes into effect.
facts.system: Personal Data Protection and Privacy Act (Act No. 11 of 2025)

facts.fact: The Act names the Information Commission as the body that monitors compliance, issues guidance and imposes penalties; the document does not say its members are appointed.
